messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from the stream-resume RFC — can we simplify the gateway state by propagating a single lease header (x-rw-lease) on ingress and letting downstream proxies use it for midstream resume? thinking about fewer handshake states rather than full session tables.

ravi: I like simpler state but how do we handle early-abort? If client cancels, do we revoke lease immediately or let a short grace window?

sam: Grace window seems necessary for retries — otherwise hedging will thrash. Maybe 2s default with config per-route. :thinking: 

jonathan: Also need to consider idempotency. If we allow resume, we might replay tokens that cause side effects. We should require idempotency-key for mutating routes or use at-most-once tokens.

sree: Billing/metrics: resuming midstream complicates token accounting. We need clear start/end markers for tokenized billing events or we under/over charge.

ravi: Proposal: header format `x-rw-lease: v1;lease_id=abc123;deadline=1710000000;flags=resume,transient` — downstream can validate and accept resume only if flags include resume.

sam: One more failure case: what if downstream model instance restarts and loses KV cache but thinks lease is valid? Need a resumability fingerprint: (lease_id, seq_hash). If mismatch, fallback to restart generation.

elaine: Good — so a handshake would be: ingress issues lease -> downstream validates fingerprint on resume -> if mismatch return 412 + resume-info -> gateway either falls back to full retry or forwards to compatible model variant.

jonathan: 412 approach is clean. Also explicitly disallow resume across regions unless cross-region token is signed by control plane.

sree: Ops note: add a telemetry tag `resume_attempt=yes|no|failed` and track latency split for resumed vs fresh. We'll need this for Optimize suggestions.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: Canary of lease-propagation feature is on in dev for gateway v2.1 (build 2026.3.21). Monitoring: edge.resume.errors = 0.

elaine: Action items: ravi to spec header & 412 payload, jonathan to update idempotency doc, sam to prototype fingerprint algo, sree to map telemetry fields. Meet Thu 10am for sync. :thumbsup: 

ravi: I'll drop a follow-up PR with header regex + example curl in the RFC branch.

sam: I'll add unit tests for seq_hash collision tolerance.

jonathan: I'll add an explicit "no-resume" flag for sensitive routes in route config.

sree: Will add cost-accounting rows to the billing schema.

elaine: Thanks — closing loop here unless anyone objects.
